narrative.overview: The user's approved Option A puts a working media demonstration at the center of the homepage. Public tools share its quiet charcoal workspace, warm amber action and readable controls. Actual photos, clips, waveforms, documents and transcripts provide the visual material; the interface makes room for them.
keyCharacteristics: A visible source, intentional settings and a measured result.
Flat tonal layers and restrained color.
Locally bundled display typography paired with native control readability.
No fabricated proof, ornamental progress or automatic model loading.

rules.name: The One Action Rule
rules.body: Reserve the strongest fill for the action that moves the current workflow forward. Navigation remains neutral.

dos: Do put the user's media and primary task first.
Do preserve local processing, cancellation, limits, integrity checks and cleanup.
donts: Don't add stock images or autoplay footage just to satisfy an image/motion count.
Don't style Studio by changing root tokens or shared editor components.
